name: Line Bundles
aliases: Anisotropic textured volume rendering using line segments
definition: A technique relying on graphics hardware to create texture by rendering and compositing many semitransparent line segments to produce an anisotropic volume rendering result.
summary: Line Bundles is a hardware-accelerated technique that visualizes 3D vector fields by compositing semitransparent line segments, clearly evidencing flow directionality unlike standard volume rendering.
